화장실.e: Literally 'makeup room', like English 'powder room'. 화장 alone means makeup.
화장실.t: 화장실이 어디예요? is one of the most useful phrases for travelers.

넣다.m: to put in, to insert, to add
넣다.x: Do you put sugar in your coffee?
넣다.e: Opposite: 빼다 (take out). 설탕을 넣다 = add sugar.

고맙다.x: Thank you so much for helping me.
고맙다.e: 고맙습니다 is the native 'thank you'; 감사합니다 is its Sino-Korean twin.

좌석.ex: 기차 좌석은 미리 예약하는 게 좋아요.
좌석.x: It's a good idea to reserve train seats in advance.
좌석.t: 좌석 appears on tickets and signs; in everyday speech, people usually say 자리.

시작되다.ex: 영화가 곧 시작되니까 휴대폰을 꺼 주세요.
시작되다.x: The movie is starting soon, so please turn off your phone.
시작되다.e: Literally 'begin making'; -되다 makes it happen on its own.
시작되다.t: 시작하다 takes an object (수업을 시작해요); 시작되다 has a subject (수업이 시작돼요).

이용하다.m: to use, to make use of (a service or facility); to take advantage of
이용하다.x: I take the subway when I go to work.

시청.x: A big festival was held in front of City Hall.
시청.t: Homonym: 시청 also means 'TV viewing', as in 시청자 'viewer'.

유행.x: Short hair is in style these days.

허락하다.m: to allow, to permit, to give permission
허락하다.ex: 부모님이 혼자 여행 가는 것을 허락하셨어요.
허락하다.x: My parents allowed me to travel alone.
허락하다.t: Pronounced [허라카다]; use 허락을 받다 for 'get permission' from someone.

가정하다.m: to suppose, to assume, to hypothesize
가정하다.ex: 내일 비가 온다고 가정하고 계획을 세웠어요.
가정하다.x: We made plans assuming it will rain tomorrow.
가정하다.e: Literally 'fix a supposition': set up a what-if.
가정하다.t: Don't confuse it with 가정 'home, household', a different word with the same sound.

제작하다.m: to produce, to make (a film, program or product)
제작하다.x: The students made a short film themselves.

지방.m: region, the provinces (outside Seoul); local area
지방.x: During the holidays, there are many cars heading out to the provinces.
지방.e: Literally 'land in a direction'; a different 지방 means 'fat'.
지방.t: In Korea 지방 usually means everywhere outside the Seoul area, not just rural places.

지방.x: Greasy food has a lot of fat.
지방.t: Homonym alert: another 지방 means 'region, provinces', as in 지방 도시 'provincial city'.

소화불량.ex: 밥을 너무 빨리 먹어서 소화불량에 걸렸어요.
소화불량.x: I ate too fast and got indigestion.
소화불량.t: In daily life, Koreans often say 체했어요 'my food is stuck' instead.

세입자.x: The landlord is looking for a new tenant.
세입자.e: Literally 'person who enters on rent'; -자 = person: 운전자, 이용자.

유익하다.ex: 오늘 들은 강의는 정말 재미있고 유익했어요.
유익하다.x: The lecture I heard today was really fun and informative.
유익하다.t: Pronounced [유이카다]; 유익한 시간 (a worthwhile time) is a common polite compliment.

전력.ex: 여름에는 에어컨 때문에 전력 사용량이 크게 늘어요.
전력.x: In summer, electricity use rises sharply because of air conditioners.
전력.t: Pronounced [절력]; don't mix it up with 전력 'all-out effort', as in 전력을 다하다.

자동화.x: As the factory became automated, many jobs disappeared.
자동화.t: Add 되다 for 'to be automated': 자동화되다.

굳이.forms: 굳이 + question or negative (굳이 그럴 필요 없어요)
굳이.m: insist on, bother to, go out of one's way to
굳이.ex: 굳이 비싼 걸 살 필요는 없어요.
굳이.x: There's no need to insist on buying the expensive one.
굳이.e: From 굳다 'to harden': stubbornly sticking to something.
굳이.t: Pronounced [구지] — palatalization; a top spelling mistake is writing 구지.

연장되다.m: to be extended, to be prolonged
연장되다.x: The meeting was extended by another hour.

탈락하다.m: to be eliminated, to drop out
탈락하다.x: Sadly, the trainee I was rooting for was eliminated.
탈락하다.t: Pronounced [탈라카다]. Takes 에서: 예선에서 탈락하다 'to be eliminated in the preliminaries'.

훌쩍이다.x: When the movie ended, people all over the theater were sniffling.
훌쩍이다.t: Pronounced [훌쩌기다]: the final ㄱ links to the next vowel. Also for a runny nose with a cold: 코를 훌쩍이다. Same meaning: 훌쩍거리다.

긴축.ex: 정부는 재정 적자를 줄이기 위해 긴축 정책을 발표했어요.
긴축.x: The government announced austerity measures to cut the budget deficit.

편성.m: organization, scheduling (of programs or a budget), formation
편성.x: The station changed its fall program lineup.

전성기.x: That singer enjoyed her heyday in the '90s.

의병.ex: 임진왜란 때 많은 백성이 의병이 되어 싸웠어요.
의병.x: During the Imjin War, many commoners fought as volunteer militia.
의병.e: Literally 'righteous soldiers': civilians who took up arms against invaders.

활성화하다.m: to revitalize, to boost, to activate
활성화하다.ex: 지역 경제를 활성화하기 위해 축제를 열었습니다.
활성화하다.x: They held a festival to revitalize the local economy.
활성화하다.e: 활성 = active, plus -화 = '-ize': 활성화, 가속화, 심화.
활성화하다.t: Also used for features and accounts: 기능을 활성화하다 means to enable a function.

판명되다.m: to be proven, to turn out (to be)
판명되다.ex: 조사 결과 그 소문은 사실이 아닌 것으로 판명되었습니다.
판명되다.x: The investigation showed that the rumor was not true.
판명되다.e: Literally 'judged clear' — the truth becomes evident.
판명되다.t: Typical pattern: N(으)로 판명되다 or -ㄴ 것으로 판명되다.

이왕.m: since (it's already so), anyway, as long as
이왕.x: Since we've come all this way, let's look around before we go.
이왕.e: Literally 'already gone': what's done is done, so make the most of it.

믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌다.forms: 믿는 도끼에 발등 찍혔어요 · 믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌 기분이에요
믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌다.m: to be betrayed by someone you trusted; stabbed in the back by a trusted person
믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌다.ex: 가장 친한 친구가 비밀을 말하다니, 믿는 도끼에 발등 찍혔어요.
믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌다.x: My best friend told my secret; I got stabbed in the back by someone I trusted.
믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌다.e: Literally 'the axe you trusted chops your own foot.'
믿는 도끼에 발등 찍힌다.t: Usually in the past tense: 믿는 도끼에 발등 찍혔다.
nb: 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다

위력.x: The typhoon was much more powerful than we thought.

제국.ex: 로마 제국은 한때 유럽의 대부분을 지배했습니다.
제국.x: The Roman Empire once ruled most of Europe.

유행어.ex: 그 개그맨의 말은 금세 유행어가 되었어요.
유행어.x: That comedian's line quickly became a catchphrase.
유행어.e: Literally 'word that is in fashion'; -어 = word or language: 신조어, 외래어.
유행어.t: 유행어 is a catchy phrase that's popular now; 신조어 is a newly coined word.

무죄추정.ex: 모든 피고인은 유죄 판결이 확정되기 전까지 무죄추정의 원칙을 적용받습니다.
무죄추정.x: Every defendant is presumed innocent until a guilty verdict becomes final.

데탕트.x: In the 1970s, détente began between the U.S. and the Soviet Union.
데탕트.e: From French 'détente' via English; Korean adds ㅡ: 데-탕-트.

개항.m: opening of ports (to foreign trade); opening of a port or airport
개항.ex: 조선은 1876년 강화도 조약으로 개항을 하게 되었어요.
개항.x: Joseon opened its ports in 1876 through the Treaty of Ganghwa.
개항.t: Today it is also used for a new airport opening, e.g. 인천공항 개항.

순국.ex: 그는 독립운동을 하다가 서른 살의 나이에 순국했어요.
순국.x: He died for his country at age thirty while fighting for independence.

신상털기.m: doxxing, digging up and exposing someone's personal info
신상털기.ex: 신상털기는 사생활 침해이며 처벌받을 수 있습니다.
신상털기.x: Doxxing is an invasion of privacy and can be punished.
신상털기.e: 신상 'personal details' + 털기 'shaking out', from 털다 'to shake out; to rob'.
신상털기.t: The verb form is 신상을 털다; being doxxed is 신상이 털리다.

토양오염.x: Using a lot of pesticide makes soil pollution worse.

고착화.m: entrenchment, becoming fixed or locked in
고착화.ex: 한국에서는 저출산 현상이 점점 고착화되고 있어요.
고착화.x: In Korea, the low birth rate is becoming more and more entrenched.
고착화.t: Pronounced [고차콰]; mostly used for negative trends, e.g. 양극화가 고착화되다.
